opening.argument: The session presents practical guidance for scaling a Tableau enterprise deployment: infrastructure, performance monitoring, capacity, team organization, and support are its stated subjects. The presentation slides reinforce that technical focus by comparing on-premise, cloud, and software-as-a-service infrastructure options and covering Tableau administration, server, and dashboard training. These are operational and educational topics, not a pathway into a transaction. Nothing in the supplied material describes an offer requiring payment, credentials, or participation in an investment or other deceptive scheme.

citations.quote: UBS | Tips for building a scalable enterprise deployment of Tableau
Learn top tips for scaling your service, such as: scaling your infrastructure, monitoring performance, capacity, organizing your team and support, and more.
